content: Sasirdub-nunud-wilubgan
Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Jeremías, sasirdub-lino be bakna, be-saderba be edinno. Melle we-sasirdub-lino be owardikuo.”
Igi-Bab-Jehová-anga-sogsa, aba an imaksad. Sasirdub-lino an baksad. Geb agine, an-saderba an edichad.
Geb Bab-Jehová anga weyob sognonibalid:
“Be sasirdub-lino-baksadi, be-saderba-naidi be unge. Éufrates-diwarse be nae, akwa-maraled-yaba sasirdub be odukuo.”
Igi Bab-Jehová anga-sogsa, aba an imaksad. Geb an Éufrates-diwarse naded, sasirdub-lino akwa-maraled-yaba an odosad.
Ibagan-undar-nasadgi, Bab-Jehová anga sokalid: “Jeremías, Éufrates-diwarse be nae, sasirdub-lino-akwa-maraled-yaba-odosgusad be sunae.”
Geb agine, an Éufrates-diwarse naded. An akwa-akwisad, agine, akwa-maraled-yaba-sasirdub-odosgusadi, an onosad. Sasirdub-lino bela nungusad, gwen bar nuedsulid.
Geb Bab-Jehová weyob anga sognonibalid:
“Ar igi be we-sasirdub nunu-daksa, deyopira an Judá-dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakdiid imakoed. Jerusalén-dulemar-na-san-dummarba-imakdimarmogad deyob an imakbaloed.

We-dule-isganamar an-ega-ibmar-soged-itobisurmaladi, na e-gwage-binsaedba ibmar imakmalad. Amar bab-dummaganba-nanadmaladi, bab-dummagan-e-nug odummodmalad. Amala bela sasirdub-lino-nunudyob gumaloed, gwen bar nued guosurmalad.”

Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar igi sasirdub-lino dule-saderba-atinne, deyopira an bela-Israel-dulemar, degi, bela-Judá-dulemar, an-Igar-Maidgi alakwaa-naguega an imaksanad. Adi, an-neggweburga-guega, an-nug-ogannodiguega, angi nue-binsaed-nikaa-nanamalaga, degi, an-gandikid-yeerdakleged-egi-oyolegega an imaksanad. Degi-inigwele, an-sogedba ibmar imaksasurmalad.”
Metemar-mamaraled
“Jeremías, an-dulamarga be sogbalo: Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob sogye: ‘Bela metemargi vino enolegoye.’ Bega sokarmalale: ‘¿Ar anmar bela metemargi-vino-enolegoed wissurmarsi?’

Geb agine be, emarbin-sogdoed, weyob Bab-Jehová sogye: ‘Bela dulemar we-yalaginmaladi an omumsaoye. Wemar an omumsaoye: Reymar-e-dad-Davidʼgi-danimalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, bela Jerusalénʼginmalad an omumsaoye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Na muchub-muchub-sarsomalaga an imakoed, babgana, e-mimmiganbo-sarsomalaga an imakbaloed. An we-dulemar bai-dakosulid, wile an ebinsaosulid. An we-dulemar obelogoed.”
Judá-dulemarga-iduakwaa-ibmar-soglenaid
Ani Jeremías dulemarga weyob sogded:
Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad sogsad:

content.text: Ar bemar anba-ibsasulile, an bemarga walagwengi arbakee bemar-san-dummarba-imakedba an bodii guoed.
Bemar, rey-gangi-siidgi be aidemala, napagi be sigmala.
Ar be-ologurgin-yeerdakleged-yoega bar bega igar maisulid.’
Wede igi be sogosunna, Bab-Dummad, be-ai-nueganga-guega be odurdaksadi be-dummaganga nug-imaksar.
¿Ar dule-uka-sichidi, e-uka ogwao be insae? Gege na e-uka ogwaed.
¿Ar achu-sapur-uka-mata-matad, e-uka ogwao be insae? Suli. Gege ogwaed.
Ar bemar deyobmodo. ¿Ar bemar ibmar-isgana-imakdimaladgi, ibmar-nuegan imakmalosi? Suli.

content: Bab-Jehová soged:
Bab-Jehová sogbalid:

content.text: ar gakansaedgi bur be bensuli gudmalad.
Bemar galagwensuli-negsichigi-nanaedi, emarga-agumakedi, degine, bemar-gambanuchu-saedi, an daksad.
